description: Harvest v9: video prompts for five more countries. Brazil, Spain, Mexico, Turkey and Vietnam come from the localized READMEs of YouMind-OpenLab/awesome-seedance-2-prompts (the same Seedance 2.0 video prompts, translated per country, many with a preview mp4); Russia, Indonesia, Turkey, Spain and Brazil also come from YouTube videos turned into prompts locally (yt-dlp download through the reverse API's downloader, keyframes, Claude Code analysis). 50 more Chinese video prompts (Veo 3, Jimeng, Kling) come from songguoxs/awesome-video-prompts. Found 2026-10-28; every repo checked against the v1-v8 graphs and every X post against all stored records. Ids start at R01. Run `node server/harvest/cli.js --v9`.

nodes.name: Seedance 2.0 video prompts by country (Brazil, Spain, Mexico, Turkey, Vietnam)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: 15 README locales, each with 107 numbered video-prompt sections (prompt in a fenced block, author, X post link, thumbnail, some with an mp4 on the repo's releases; video-urls.json maps 1,000 more). CC BY 4.0. Only the English README is not used (no country). 10 of the 106 posts are already stored by v1-v8 and are skipped. Same videos in five translations: each translation is its own record, tagged with the country.

nodes.name: songguoxs/awesome-video-prompts (Veo 3, Jimeng, Kling video prompts)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: 50 numbered cases with JSON or text prompts and their X post link; none of the 50 X posts is in any earlier version. No licence file: preview plus link. Chinese README, English prompts.

nodes.name: YouTube videos turned into prompts (Turkey, Indonesia, Russia, Spain, Brazil)
nodes.notes: yt-dlp (through server/reverse/fetch.js) downloaded the first 60 s of 7 AI-generated short videos from channels in those countries (Kaan Alper, Pendekringkas, Studio Paprika, an AI-prompts channel, Cheems, Fábrica de Anúncios IA); ffmpeg made an 8-frame contact sheet of each and Claude Code wrote the scene prompts from the frames (the reverse API's own vision step needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY, which is not set). Three more Indonesian videos were refused by YouTube (403) and are not included. Prompts describe only what is visible and audible; the videos stay on this machine, the site uses YouTube's thumbnail and links to the original.

excluded.name: geekjourneyx/awesome-ai-video-prompts
excluded.reason: Prompt files are empty stubs ('content to be added').

excluded.name: Native-language GitHub video-prompt repos for Brazil, Spain, Russia, Turkey, Indonesia
excluded.reason: Searched GitHub and the web in Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, Turkish and Indonesian: none exists; the localized YouMind READMEs and YouTube videos are the sources.

excluded.name: YouMind README.md and the 10 other locales (de, fr, it, ja, ko, hi, th, zh, pt-PT)
excluded.reason: English has no country; de, fr, hi are covered by v7; ja, ko, zh by v4; the rest are later countries. Kept for a later version.

excluded.name: ulazai.com prompt directory, vivideo.ai examples
excluded.reason: Websites that answered the harvester with an empty page; no confirmed licence. Leads only.

excluded.name: YouTube tutorial videos (talking-head and screen-recording how-tos in pt, es, tr, vi)
excluded.reason: They teach tools; reversing them gives screen recordings, not video prompts. Only AI-generated showcase videos were used.
